text:
anita: quick sync — we need to lock the client-visible error contract before the rollout tomorrow. current prototype exposes route ids and kernel names; that's leaking infra.

joseph: saw customer ticket — "received shard-83 error" and they had no idea what to do. map to human-friendly text.

kai: proposal: stable schema with fields: error_code, error_category, message, correlation_id, optional retry_after. keep internal fields in an x-internal object only returned to console/authorized keys.

anita: example?

kai: ```json
{
  "error_code": "MODEL_OVERLOAD",
  "error_category": "capacity",
  "message": "Service is temporarily busy; try again in a few seconds.",
  "correlation_id": "rwd_3f7a2b",
  "retry_after": 2
}
```

maya: prefer an explicit "action" field instead of free-text guidance so UIs can render a consistent CTA. e.g., action: "retry" / "switch-model" / "contact-support".

samir: telemetry note: include trace_id and a reversible-but-hashed request_fingerprint for repro, but ensure hashing is irreversible and strips PII. we should also sample at 1% by default.

joseph: also add a verbosity knob with three levels: user (default), debug (dev teams), internal (console only). header suggestion: x-rwd-error-verbosity, SDK flag too.

kate: header approach is fine but breaks older SDKs and some mobile clients. fallback behavior should be account-level flag + conservative default.

anita: rollout UX: console shows sample user-facing messages and a single aggregated internal error blob for SREs. do NOT expose stack traces in preview panes.

maya: metrics: we need bucketed telemetry for (error_category, error_code, org_id) so product can quick-filter dashboards. also a top-5 example messages widget.

samir: on taxonomy: clarify quota vs rate vs capacity — propose: quota_exceeded, throttled (rate), capacity (backpressure). each maps to recommended action we show to customers.

joseph: implement ErrorKind enum in SDKs with stable string names and numeric codes. servers return code + kind; SDK surfaces both and adds human_message.

kate: legal/security must vet. absolutely no prompt snippets or user content in error fields. add a lint rule in response generators and a unit test.

anita: rollout plan: canary 5% -> dev orgs with x-rwd-error-verbosity=debug for 24h, collect examples, then 25% for 48h, watch support ticket queue.

deploy-bot: canary deploy to edge cluster rwd-edge-12 started at 1999994450

maya: small question — do we include locale for localized messages? maybe optional "lang" field, default en-US.

samir: agreed, add optional "lang" with RFC4646 codes. ensure UI falls back to en-US.

joseph: follow-ups: PR for API contract, SDK changes, console wireframes. who takes which?

anita: i'll own the API contract and spec. joseph owns SDK changes. maya owns console UI and example widget. samir owns telemetry + lint. kate/legal for sign-off.

anita: thanks all — i'll post the RFC link in #eng-releases when it's up. :thumbsup:
